column1: # BETIS HII-region catalogue - extinction-corrected emission-line fluxes
#   Every other line and its error is NORMALISED BY Hbeta
#   To recover an absolute flux:  F(line) = <line> * Hb4861   [cgs]
#   The errors are scaled by F(Hbeta) only; the uncertainty of Hbeta
#   itself is NOT folded into them - it is given once
#   Rows without a measured Hbeta have no ratios at all (all blank).
# Fluxes are corrected for internal extinction using the region's own
# E(B-V) clamped at >=0); A_V [mag] is that correction.
# OH = 12+log(O/H) from the O3N2 calibrator (blank where [O III] or Hb
# is undetected). ra/dec in degrees J2000; XPIX/YPIX are 1-based FITS
# pixel coordinates in the galaxy's segmentation map.
